items.title_zh: 华尔街见闻早餐 | 2026年11月27日
items.body_zh: 美股休市，AI交易抛售暂缓，泛欧股指反弹近2%、科技板块涨近3%，伦铜等基本金属反弹；布油涨超2%、三连涨。 美国针对中国进口产品税率将提升20%，中国外交部：中方将继续采取必要措施捍卫自身正当权益。中国商务部：坚决反对美对中国等经济体加征301关税；望美中推动对等降税安排尽快落地实施。商务部：中方将密切关注欧方混动汽车保障措施后续调查进展。 特朗普称Q3美国GDP数据造假、被蓄意压低，称此举是为了干扰中期选举。
items.title_en: Wall Street Journal Breakfast | November 27, 2026.
items.body_en: With U.S. markets closed, the AI-driven sell-off paused. Pan-European stock indices rebounded nearly 2%, and the tech sector rose almost 3%. Base metals, including London copper, also rebounded. Brent crude oil rose over 2%, marking its third consecutive day of gains. The U.S. will raise tariffs on Chinese imports by 20%. China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that China will continue to take necessary measures to safeguard its legitimate rights and interests. China's Ministry of Commerce: We firmly oppose the U.S. imposing additional Section 301 tariffs on China and other economies; we hope that the U.S. and China will promote the implementation of reciprocal tariff reduction arrangements as soon as possible. Ministry of Commerce: China will closely monitor the progress of the EU's subsequent investigation into safeguard measures for hybrid vehicles. Trump claimed that the U.S. Q3 GDP data was falsified and deliberately suppressed, stating that this was done to interfere with the midterm elections.

items.title_zh: 四大商业银行已与上市公司签订股票回购增持贷款合同超6000亿元
items.body_zh: 从工商银行等商业银行了解到，在中国人民银行近日会同金融监管总局、中国证监会等部门明确将股票回购增持再贷款政策由阶段性安排转为长期制度性安排，并进一步下调再贷款利率之后，工商银行、农业银行、中国银行、建设银行等多家银行迅速落实有关部署，加大股票回购增持贷款投放力度。目前，四大商业银行已签订上市公司股票回购增持贷款合同超6000亿元。（央视）
items.title_en: The four major commercial banks have signed share buyback increase loan contracts with listed companies worth over RMB 600 billion.
items.body_en: According to information from commercial banks such as the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, after the People's Bank of China, in collaboration with the National Financial Regulatory Administration, the CSRC, and other departments, recently clarified the transition of the share buyback and additional share purchase relending policy from a temporary arrangement to a long-term institutional arrangement, and further lowered the relending interest rate, several banks including the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, Agricultural Bank of China, Bank of China, and China Construction Bank promptly implemented the relevant measures, increasing the issuance of loans for share buybacks and additional share purchases. Currently, the four major commercial banks have signed loan contracts for share buybacks and increased holdings of listed company stocks exceeding 600 billion yuan. (CCTV).

items.title_zh: 金银遭遇深度回调
items.body_zh: 黄金走势急转直下，3500美元/盎司被击穿。11月25日晚间，在美联储加息预期升温的压力下，黄金现货价格直接被“打到”3426.32美元/盎司，较年内高点5598.75美元/盎司下跌2172...
items.title_en: Gold and silver experience a sharp pullback.
items.body_en: Gold prices plummeted, falling below $3,500 per ounce. On the evening of November 25, under the pressure of rising expectations of an interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve, the spot price of gold was directly "driven down" to $3,426.32/oz, a drop of $2,172 from the year's high of $5,598.75/oz...

items.title_zh: 动力电池格局重塑，二线阵营分化明显
items.body_zh: 据统计，今年前三季度，国内8家动力电池及锂电上市公司中，半数实现净利润同比增长。其中宁德时代以645.30亿元归母净利润居首，比亚迪223.45亿元、亿纬锂能52.40亿元紧随其后；从增幅看，鹏辉能源以928.81%领跑，中创新航、亿纬锂能分别增长99.50%和86.11%；降幅最大的为国轩高科，同比下降66.48%。
items.title_en: Reshaping of the power battery landscape, with clear differentiation within the second-tier camp.
items.body_en: According to statistics, in the first three quarters of this year, half of the eight listed companies in China that manufacture automotive batteries and lithium-ion batteries achieved year-on-year growth in net profit. Among them, CATL led with a net profit attributable to shareholders of 64.53 billion yuan, followed closely by BYD at 22.345 billion yuan and EVE Energy at 5.24 billion yuan. In terms of growth rates, Penghui Energy led with 928.81%, while CALB and EVE Energy grew by 99.50% and 86.11%, respectively. The largest decline was seen in Gotion High-tech, which was down 66.48% year-on-year.

items.title_zh: 中国农业银行
items.body_zh: 农业银行已与近200家上市公司达成合作意向，签订股票回购增持贷款合同超1500亿元。
items.title_en: Agricultural Bank of China Limited.
items.body_en: The Agricultural Bank of China has reached cooperation agreements with nearly 200 listed companies and signed share buyback and shareholding increase loan contracts exceeding RMB 150 billion.

items.title_zh: 东京通胀加速 日本央行警惕物价压力
items.body_zh: 日本首都东京通胀升至今年最高水平，日本央行持续保持警惕，力求将物价涨幅稳定在2%目标附近。 日本总务省周五公布数据，东京11月不含生鲜食品的消费者物价指数同比上涨2...
items.title_en: Tokyo inflation accelerates, Bank of Japan wary of price pressures.
items.body_en: Inflation in Tokyo, Japan's capital, has risen to its highest level this year. The Bank of Japan remains vigilant, striving to stabilize price increases around its 2% target. Data released by Japan's Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications on Friday showed that Tokyo's Consumer Price Index (excluding fresh food) rose by 2% year-on-year in November...

items.title_zh: 左侧分批右侧加码，私募激辩科技股走向
items.body_zh: 近期，全球科技资产大幅波动，科技股的走向已成为私募机构当下讨论的热门话题：有机构看到大资金连续增持、空头交易拥挤度升至罕见水平等情况，主张逐步加大布局力度；也有机构提示，估值出清不等于风险出清，产业层面的验证仍需时间。综合多位受访私募人士的研判，私募对本轮科技股调整的“定性”更多是高预期、高拥挤下的估值重估，而非AI产业逻辑的证伪。真正的分歧不在“要不要抄底”，而在“何时下手、买什么”。（中证报）
items.title_en: Selling off on the left, buying up on the right: Private equity firms fiercely debate the future of tech stocks.
items.body_en: Recently, global tech assets have experienced significant fluctuations, and the direction of tech stocks has become a hot topic of discussion among private equity firms. Some firms have observed situations such as continuous large-scale buying and an unusually high level of short-selling activity, leading them to advocate for gradually increasing their investment in this sector. However, other firms have cautioned that a valuation correction does not equate to the elimination of risk, and validation at the industry level still requires time. Based on the analyses of several private equity professionals interviewed, the "characterization" of this round of tech stock corrections by private equity firms is more about a revaluation under high expectations and high crowding, rather than a disconfirmation of the AI industry's rationale. The real point of contention is not whether to buy at the bottom, but rather when to act and what to buy. (China Securities Journal).

items.title_zh: 全球燃油供应回升，炼油利润跌至数月低点
items.body_zh: 来源：华尔街见闻 伊朗战争对能源市场的冲击正在退潮。随着全球炼厂开足马力补充供应、中东出口恢复以及石油消费走弱，将原油加工为燃油的利润已跌至数月来最低水平...
items.title_en: Global fuel supply rebounds, refining margins fall to multi-month lows.
items.body_en: Source: Wall Street Journal The impact of the Iran war on the energy market is receding. As global refineries operate at full capacity to replenish supplies, Middle Eastern exports resume, and oil consumption weakens, the profit margin for refining crude oil into fuel has dropped to its lowest level in months...

items.title_zh: 固态冲刺量产，场景抢先卡位，锂电产业寻找新增长极
items.body_zh: 1月26日，2026（第十六届）高工锂电年会的固态电池专场座无虚席。记者在现场采访了解到，虽然全固态电池尚未大规模量产，但很多上市公司、科研机构等参会代表都紧盯与固态电池有关的技术、产业、政策等最新动向与趋势研判。不少上市公司透露了固态电池布局最新进展，亿纬锂能正开发脑机接口固态电池，国轩高科计划搭建2GWh示范线，利元亨于今年交付了数百兆瓦级全固态电池整线设备。
items.title_en: Solid-state batteries are entering mass production, securing early positions in various applications, and the lithium-ion battery industry is seeking new growth drivers.
items.body_en: On January 26, the solid-state battery session at the 2026 (16th) GGII Lithium Battery Annual Conference was packed to capacity. From on-site interviews, the reporter learned that although all-solid-state batteries have not yet entered mass production, many representatives from listed companies, research institutions, and other organizations attending the conference are closely monitoring the latest developments and trends related to solid-state battery technology, industry, and policies. Many listed companies have disclosed the latest progress in their solid-state battery strategies. EVE Energy is developing a brain-computer interface solid-state battery, Gotion High-tech plans to build a 2 GWh demonstration line, and Liyuanheng delivered hundreds of megawatt-level all-solid-state battery production line equipment this year.

items.title_zh: 巴西航空工业公司：美国对巴产飞机征收新关税或推高机票价格
items.body_zh: 11月26日，巴西航空工业公司首席执行官弗朗西斯科·戈麦斯·内托表示，美国对巴西产飞机征收10%的从价关税的提议可能会推高机票价格，并给美国通胀带来压力。巴航产E175飞机是目前美国运营最广泛的机型之一，对该机型征收关税将对航司产生影响，需要为飞机支付更多费用。这最终会体现在机票价格上，甚至可能影响通胀。
items.title_en: Embraer: New U.S. tariffs on Brazilian-made aircraft may push up airfare prices.
items.body_en: On November 26, Embraer CEO Francisco Gomes Neto stated that the U.S. proposal to impose a 10% ad valorem tariff on Brazilian-made aircraft could drive up airfare prices and put pressure on U.S. inflation. Embraer's E175 aircraft is currently one of the most widely operated models in the United States. Imposing tariffs on this model will affect airlines, requiring them to pay more for the aircraft. This will ultimately be reflected in airfare prices and may even affect inflation.

items.title_zh: 欧洲理事会主席Costa
items.body_zh: 欧元区成员国同意由推荐的原西班牙央行行长de Cos出任下一届欧洲央行行长。 欧元区成员国同意对Boone、Brunnermeier出任欧洲央行官员的推荐。 这为12月份正式任命欧洲央行相关官员的峰会铺平道路。
items.title_en: Costa, President of the European Council.
items.body_en: The eurozone member states have agreed to appoint the recommended former Spanish PBOC Governor de Cos as the next ECB President. The eurozone member states have agreed to the recommendations for Boone and Brunnermeier to serve as ECB officials. This paves the way for the December summit to formally appoint the relevant ECB officials.

items.title_zh: 土耳其调查前银监机构负责人
items.body_zh: 据土耳其媒体11月26日报道，土耳其财政部长迈赫迈特·希姆谢克已授权调查前银行监管机构负责人沙哈普·卡夫奇奥卢。调查涉及利用投资基金不当获利的丑闻，卡夫奇奥卢被指认涉嫌贿赂、滥用职权等不法行为。这一丑闻9月被曝光后持续发酵，涉及数百名嫌疑人，其中包括数名在任及前任高官。（新华社）
items.title_en: Turkey investigates former head of banking regulator.
items.body_en: According to Turkish media reports on November 26, Turkish Minister of Finance Mehmet Şimşek has authorized an investigation into Şahap Kavcıoğlu, the former head of the banking regulator. The investigation concerns a scandal involving the improper use of investment funds for personal gain. Kavcıoğlu has been accused of illegal activities such as bribery and abuse of power. This scandal continued to escalate after it was exposed in September, involving hundreds of suspects, including several current and former high-ranking officials. (Xinhua News Agency).

items.title_en: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Iran.
items.body_en: During a phone call with his Kuwaiti counterpart, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi expressed regret over the casualties and property damage caused by the incident.

items.title_zh: 特朗普在高尔夫球场称：修订后的GDP数据是“伪造的”，呼吁展开调查
items.body_zh: 美国总统特朗普指责其自己的政府“蓄意”压低美国经济增长数据，他利用一次常规的数据修订，在毫无证据的情况下提出了干预选举的指控。 特朗普指出，GDP数据显示经济在第三季度实现了4.3%的年化增长——较之前发布的3.4%的预估值进行了上修——并称这是一个“巨大的差异”。 “刚刚披露，选前公布的经济‘真实数据’系伪造，”他在没有提供任何证据的情况下表示。“我要求立即对此事展开调查。这并非小错，而是重大且蓄意的错误。
items.title_en: Trump claims on the golf course that the revised GDP figures are "fabricated" and calls for an investigation.
items.body_en: U.S. President Trump accused his own administration of "deliberately" suppressing U.S. economic growth data, using a routine data revision to make unsubstantiated allegations of election interference. Trump pointed out that GDP data showed the economy grew at an annualized rate of 4.3% in the third quarter — an upward revision from the previously reported estimate of 3.4% — and called it a "huge difference." "It has just been revealed that the 'real' economic data released before the election was falsified," he said, without providing any evidence. "I demand an immediate investigation into this matter. This is not a minor error, but a significant and deliberate one.

items.title_zh: 法国拟削减太阳能补贴，或波及Engie旗下100兆瓦项目
items.body_zh: 公用事业公司Engie发言人在一份声明中表示，法国政府一项旨在终止2006-10年期间开发的太阳能项目部分补贴的提案，可能影响Engie在法国拥有的200座光伏电站中的不到15座。 受2027年预算法案修正案影响的Engie项目总装机容量约为100兆瓦，而该公司在法国的太阳能总装机容量为1.5吉瓦。
items.title_en: France plans to cut solar subsidies, which may affect Engie's 100-megawatt project.
items.body_en: In a statement, a spokesperson for the utility company Engie said that a French government proposal to end partial subsidies for solar projects developed between 2006 and 2010 could affect fewer than 15 of the 200 photovoltaic power plants Engie owns in France. The total installed capacity of Engie's projects affected by the 2027 budget bill amendment is approximately 100 megawatts, while the company's total installed solar capacity in France is 1.5 gigawatts.

items.title_zh: 巴西副总统：美国对巴西加征新关税完全不合理
items.body_zh: 11月26日，巴西副总统阿尔克明表示，美国提出对巴西加征的新关税完全不合理，巴西政府将尽全力扭转这一局面。阿尔克明强调，世界上不存在航空领域的关税，航空这样具有战略意义的领域不征收关税是传统。（央视）
items.title_en: Brazilian Vice President: The U.S.'s imposition of new tariffs on Brazil is completely unreasonable.
items.body_en: On November 26, Brazilian Vice President Geraldo Alckmin stated that the new tariffs proposed by the United States on Brazil are completely unreasonable, and the Brazilian government will do everything in its power to reverse this situation. Alckmin emphasized that there are no tariffs in the aviation sector worldwide, and it is traditional not to impose tariffs in a strategically important sector like aviation. (CCTV).

items.title_zh: 报道：日本JERA与Anthropic、Meta洽谈建设数据中心
items.body_zh: 日本最大发电企业JERA已与Anthropic、Meta及其他美国科技巨头展开洽谈，计划在东京地区发电厂附近建设数据中心。JERA全球首席执行官兼董事长可儿行夫（Yukio Kani）近期表示，该能源集团同时也在与亚马逊、微软和谷歌进行洽谈，据《日本经济新闻》报道。
items.title_en: Report: Japan's JERA in talks with Anthropic and Meta to build data centers.
items.body_en: JERA, Japan's largest power generator, has entered into discussions with Anthropic, Meta, and other U.S. tech giants to build data centers near power plants in the Tokyo area. JERA's Global CEO and Chairman, Yukio Kani, recently stated that the energy group is also in discussions with Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, according to the Nikkei.

story.title_zh: 省下一滴焊料的人，成了首富
story.title_en: The Man Who Saved One Drop of Solder
story.body_zh: 洛克菲勒参观自家炼油厂，问工人焊一个油桶用几滴焊料。答：四十滴。他让人试试三十八滴，一滴不漏。就为这两滴，工厂每年省下大笔钱。他说：巨大的财富，就是对小事的巨大认真。
story.body_en: Young Rockefeller once watched workers seal oil barrels. He asked how many drops of solder each barrel took. Forty, they said. He asked them to try thirty-eight. Not a single barrel leaked. His ledgers went to three decimal places. Great wealth comes from great attention to small things.

lines.en: Ohio, eighteen seventy. A quiet man in a dark suit is watching workers seal oil barrels, one by one.
lines.zh: 俄亥俄，1870 年。一个穿黑西装的安静男人，正看着工人们一个一个焊接油桶。

lines.en: How many drops of solder does one barrel take?
lines.zh: 焊一个桶，要用几滴焊料？

lines.en: Forty drops, sir. Same as always.
lines.zh: 四十滴，先生。一直都是四十滴。

lines.en: Try thirty-eight.
lines.zh: 试试三十八滴。

lines.en: They tried. Not a single barrel leaked. Those two drops saved the plant real money, every single year.
lines.zh: 工人们试了。一滴都没漏。就这两滴，每年给工厂省下真金白银。

lines.en: Great wealth comes from great attention to small things. Saved one drop at a time.
lines.zh: 巨大的财富，就是对小事的巨大认真，一滴一滴攒出来的。

joke.title_zh: 杯子半满？工程师说杯子太大了
joke.title_en: Half Full? The Engineer Says the Glass Is Too Big
joke.body_zh: 乐观主义者说杯子是半满的，悲观主义者说是半空的，工程师看了看说：这个杯子比实际需要的大了一倍。放到市场里也一样：同一个行情，多头看到机会，空头看到风险，而真正干活的人只关心一件事——估值和实际价值差多少。别急着站队，先量一量杯子。
joke.body_en: The optimist says the glass is half full. The pessimist says it is half empty. The engineer looks at both and says, the glass is twice as big as it needs to be. Markets work the same way. The bull sees opportunity. The bear sees risk. The person doing the actual work asks only one question. How far is the price from the real value? Do not rush to pick a side. First, measure the glass.

items.title_zh: 华尔街见闻早餐 | 2026年11月26日
items.body_zh: AI抛售拖累美股盘中重挫，逢低买盘力撑道指转涨；避险需求推升美债，10年期美债收益率盘中降10个基点至两月新低；贵金属V型反转，油价走高。 美联储青睐的通胀指标——美国PCE物价指数10月同比涨3.8%、涨幅创三年半新高，核心PCE同比超预期涨3.3%，12月加息几成定局。 美国三季度GDP年化季环比增速大幅上修至4.3%；10月耐用品订单环比增长初值0.2%、超预期放缓。
items.title_en: Wall Street Journal Breakfast | November 26, 2026.
items.body_en: The sell-off in AI stocks weighed on U.S. equities, causing a sharp intraday decline. However, buying on dips supported the Dow Jones Industrial Average, leading to a turnaround. Safe-haven demand boosted U.S. Treasury bonds, with the 10-year Treasury yield falling by 10 basis points intraday to a two-month low. Precious metals experienced a V-shaped reversal, and oil prices rose. The Federal Reserve's preferred inflation indicator — the U.S. PCE price index — rose by 3.8% year-on-year in October, marking the highest increase in three and a half years. The core PCE rose by 3.3% year-on-year, exceeding expectations, making a December rate hike almost certain. The annualized quarter-on-quarter growth rate of U.S. GDP in the third quarter was significantly revised upwards to 4.3%. The preliminary figure for the month-on-month growth in durable goods orders in October was 0.2%, a slowdown that exceeded expectations.

items.title_zh: 今年以来逾2300家上市公司披露并购重组进展
items.body_zh: 艾为电子拟收购钰泰半导体，加速模拟芯片平台化布局；朗特智能拟以6.63亿元收购成都奥捷51%股权，切入光互联赛道；纳芯微拟以4.87亿元收购隔空智能78%股权，补齐毫米波雷达版图……近期，A股上市公司并购重组动作密集，市场热度持续攀升，交易的“科技成色”明显提升。以首次披露日期为口径，今年以来A股市场2300余家上市公司披露并购重组进展。
items.title_en: More than 2,300 listed companies have disclosed progress on mergers, acquisitions, and restructurings since the beginning of this year.
items.body_en: Awinic Semiconductor plans to acquire Richtek Technology to accelerate its analog chip platform strategy; Longtech Smart Technology plans to acquire a 51% stake in Chengdu O-Net Technologies for RMB 663 million to enter the optical interconnection sector; NavInfo plans to acquire a 78% stake in Gekong Intelligent Technology for RMB 487 million to complete its millimeter-wave radar portfolio... Recently, A-share listed companies have been engaging in frequent mergers and restructuring activities, with market enthusiasm continuing to rise and the "technological content" of transactions significantly increasing. Based on the date of initial disclosure, over 2,300 listed companies in the A-share market have disclosed progress on mergers and acquisitions (M&A) and restructuring since the beginning of this year.

items.title_zh: 上市公司回购增持升温，银行加快投放专项贷款
items.body_zh: 近期，金融机构明显加大对上市公司股票回购增持的支持力度。近日，震裕科技、瑞丰新材、赣锋锂业、复星医药等公告称，已取得金融机构股票回购增持专项贷款承诺函。从回购资金来源看，上市公司除了运用自有资金，还借助银行提供的专项贷款。截至11月25日，11月以来已有123家上市公司公告取得股票回购增持专项贷款承诺函，这一节奏较往月明显提速。
items.title_en: Listed companies' share buybacks are on the rise, and banks are accelerating the issuance of special loans.
items.body_en: Recently, financial institutions have significantly increased their support for listed companies' share buybacks. Recently, Zhenyu Technology, Ruifeng New Materials, Ganfeng Lithium, Fosun Pharmaceutical, and others announced that they had obtained letters of commitment from financial institutions for special loans for share buybacks and increased shareholdings. In terms of the source of funds for share buybacks, listed companies not only use their own funds but also rely on special loans provided by banks. As of November 25, 123 listed companies have announced that they have obtained letters of commitment for special loans for share buybacks and increased shareholdings since November, marking a significant acceleration compared to previous months.

items.title_zh: 建行：已与百余家客户签订超千亿元股票回购增持贷款合同 护航资本市场稳定
items.body_zh: 从建设银行获悉，中国人民银行、金融监管总局、中国证监会召开支持资本市场两项工具座谈会以来，该行落实相关部署要求，第一时间组织全行开展客户走访和政策宣贯，畅通传导路径，优化服务流程，靠前对接上市公司需求，加力推动股票回购增持贷款投放，助力维护资本市场平稳运行。截至目前，建设银行已与百余家客户签订超千亿元股票回购增持贷款合同。座谈会召开后，建设银行已触达近百家上市公司，开展政策宣贯及传导。（上证报）
items.title_en: China Construction Bank: Has signed share buyback and shareholding increase loan contracts worth over RMB 100 billion with more than 100 clients to support the stability of the capital market.
items.body_en: According to information from the China Construction Bank, since the People's Bank of China, the National Financial Regulatory Administration, and the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) held a symposium on two tools to support the capital market, the bank has implemented the relevant deployment requirements. It promptly organized the entire bank to conduct client visits and policy dissemination, ensuring smooth transmission channels, optimizing service processes, proactively addressing the needs of listed companies, and intensifying efforts to promote the issuance of loans for share buybacks and increased shareholdings, thereby contributing to the stable operation of the capital market. To date, China Construction Bank has signed share buyback and shareholding increase loan contracts worth over RMB 100 billion with more than 100 clients. Following the symposium, China Construction Bank has reached out to nearly 100 listed companies to disseminate and communicate policies. (Shanghai Securities News).

items.title_zh: 公募四季度加仓频现，偏爱科技和高增长标的
items.body_zh: A股上市公司近期密集披露回购股份事项前十大股东（含流通股东）相关信息公告。越来越多的公募基金10月以来的调仓动向浮出水面，其中不乏朱少醒、杨锐文、崔宸龙等多位知名基金经理的最新操作曝光。整体来看，10月以来的市场回调中，主动权益基金加仓仍以AI算力、半导体等科技品种为主，且偏爱业绩高增长标的，但节奏相对审慎，普遍表现为小幅加仓。（中证报）
items.title_en: Public funds frequently increased positions in Q4, favoring technology and high-growth stocks.
items.body_en: A-share listed companies have recently been making frequent disclosures of information related to the top ten shareholders (including floating shareholders) in connection with share buyback matters. An increasing number of portfolio rebalancing moves by public funds since October have come to light, including the latest actions of several well-known fund managers such as Zhu Shaoxing, Yang Ruiwen, and Cui Chenlong. Overall, during the market pullback since October, active equity funds have continued to increase their holdings primarily in tech sectors such as AI computing power and semiconductors, with a preference for high-growth stocks. However, the pace of these increases has been relatively cautious, generally manifesting as modest additions to positions. (China Securities Journal).

items.title_zh: 美国10年期国债收益率跌超8个基点
items.body_zh: 周三（11月25日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期国债收益率跌8.36个基点，报4.8461%，亚太盘初微幅低开，随后持续走低，美国PCE通胀指标、GDP等数据发布后，在00:03刷新日低至4.7987%。 两年期美债收益率跌4.55个基点，报4.6374%，美联储青睐的PCE通胀指标出炉后，在美股盘初刷新日低至4.5754%；30年期美债收益率跌8.06个基点，报5.2397%。
items.title_en: U.S. 10-year Treasury yields fall by over 8 basis points.
items.body_en: At the close of trading in New York on Wednesday (November 25), the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield fell by 8.36 basis points to 4.8461%. It opened slightly lower at the start of the Asia-Pacific session and continued to decline thereafter. Following the release of U.S. PCE inflation indicators, GDP, and other data, it hit a new intraday low of 4.7987% at 00:03. The yield on the 2-year U.S. Treasury note fell by 4.55 basis points to 4.6374%. After the release of the Federal Reserve's preferred PCE inflation indicator, it hit a new intraday low of 4.5754% at the start of U.S. trading. The yield on the 30-year U.S. Treasury note fell by 8.06 basis points to 5.2397%.

items.title_zh: 爱奇艺：收到纳斯达克不合规通知，暂不停牌，180日内整改
items.body_zh: 爱奇艺发文称，已收到纳斯达克的书面通知。该通知属于纳斯达克上市规则下的常规程序性沟通，仅为不合规通知，不会导致公司的美国存托票据（ADS）被立即退市或暂停交易。公司的ADS目前将继续以现有股票代码在纳斯达克保持上市和交易。公司收到该通知不会影响公司的业务运营，公司向美国证券交易委员会履行的信息披露义务保持不变。公司目前正在评估各种可行方案，以在180个自然日内重新符合纳斯达克的持续上市要求，维持上市地位。
items.title_en: iQiyi: Received a notice of non-compliance from Nasdaq; trading will not be suspended for the time being, and corrective actions must be taken within 180 days.
items.body_en: iQiyi issued a statement saying that it had received a written notice from Nasdaq. This notice is a routine procedural communication under Nasdaq's listing rules and is merely a notice of non-compliance. It will not result in the immediate delisting or suspension of trading of the company's American Depositary Shares (ADSs). The company's ADSs will currently continue to be listed and traded on Nasdaq under the existing ticker symbol. The company's receipt of this notice will not affect its business operations, and the company's obligation to disclose information to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission remains unchanged. The company is currently evaluating various feasible options to regain compliance with Nasdaq's continued listing requirements within 180 calendar days and maintain its listing status.

items.title_zh: 两大AI公司同日公布“VP≠VNP”问题证明
items.body_zh: 继人工智能（AI）辅助证明黎曼猜想引发关注后，AI数学研究再获新进展。北京时间24日，美国人工智能公司Anthropic和OpenAI先后在各自的GitHub官方仓库发布论文，给出被称为“代数版P≠NP”的“VP≠VNP”问题的证明，两者发布时间仅相差约4小时。相关成果有望为破解七大千禧年数学难题之一的P与NP问题提供新思路。Anthropic表示，这项成果由其内部研究版本的Claude模型完成。
items.title_en: Two major AI companies release proof of the "VP≠VNP" problem on the same day.
items.body_en: Following the attention generated by the AI-assisted proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, AI mathematical research has made further progress. On September 24, Beijing time, U.S. artificial intelligence companies Anthropic and OpenAI successively published papers in their respective official GitHub repositories, providing proofs for the "VP≠VNP" problem, known as the "algebraic version of P≠NP." The two papers were published only about 4 hours apart. These findings are expected to offer new insights into solving the P versus NP problem, one of the seven Millennium Prize Problems in mathematics. Anthropic stated that this achievement was accomplished by its internal research version of the Claude model.

items.title_zh: 美股大类资产类ETF多数收涨，布油基金涨超2.8%，纳指ETF跌超0.6%
items.body_zh: 周三（11月25日），恐慌指数做多收涨3.97%，美国布伦特油价基金涨2.86%，美国房地产ETF涨0.93%，美国国债20+年ETF涨0.92%，罗素2000指数ETF涨0.65%，黄金ETF涨0.61%，大豆基金、道指ETF、欧元做多至多涨0.36%。
items.title_en: Most US equity broad asset class ETFs closed higher, with the Brent Oil Fund rising over 2.8% and the Nasdaq ETF falling over 0.6%.
items.body_en: On Wednesday (November 25), the VIX Index (Fear Index) long positions closed up 3.97%, the US Brent Oil Fund rose 2.86%, the US Real Estate ETF rose 0.93%, the US Treasury 20+ Year ETF rose 0.92%, the Russell 2000 Index ETF rose 0.65%, the Gold ETF rose 0.61%, and the Soybean Fund, Dow Jones ETF, and Euro long positions rose up to 0.36%.

items.title_zh: 巴西政府声明
items.body_zh: 对美国决定建议对进口飞机和糖征收新关税表示愤慨。 很明显，这项新建议意在向政府施压，迫使其对国家监管措施作出改变。 将继续寻求谈判解决方案，不排除采取对等措施的可能性。
items.title_en: Statement by the Government of Brazil.
items.body_en: We express our indignation at the U.S. decision to propose new tariffs on imported aircraft and sugar. It is clear that this new proposal is intended to put pressure on the government to force it to make changes to national regulatory measures. We will continue to seek a negotiated solution, but we do not rule out the possibility of taking reciprocal measures.

items.title_zh: AI担忧加剧，CoreWeave与英伟达信用风险指标双双创历史新高
items.body_zh: 随着华尔街对科技行业为人工智能融资而进行的创纪录举债感到日益恐慌，CoreWeave Inc.和英伟达的信用风险指标周三双双创下历史新高，同时衡量市场恐慌情绪的指标也再次达到3月份以来的最高水平。 根据ICE数据服务公司的数据，为CoreWeave债务提供五年期违约保护的成本（CDS利差）最多飙升了2.09个百分点，创下历史最大单日涨幅，达到每年15.34个百分点。
items.title_en: AI concerns intensify as CoreWeave and Nvidia's credit risk indicators both hit all-time highs.
items.body_en: As Wall Street grows increasingly alarmed by the tech industry's record-breaking borrowing to finance artificial intelligence, CoreWeave Inc.Both CoreWeave Inc. and Nvidia's credit risk indicators hit all-time highs on Wednesday, while the indicator measuring market panic also reached its highest level since March. According to ICE Data Services, the cost of five-year default protection on CoreWeave's debt (CDS spread) surged by up to 2.09 percentage points, marking the largest single-day increase on record, reaching 15.34 percentage points per annum.

items.title_zh: 穆迪：维持英伟达评级、前景展望不变
items.body_zh: Aa1评级及稳定展望反映英伟达异常强劲的竞争和财务状况。 英伟达首席执行官回归恢复了战略连续性，但一些治理问题仍未解决。 对英伟达的评级和稳定展望也考虑了新出口管制规则对先进半导体销售的潜在影响。 英伟达面临的监管与政府审查依然处于高位，且可能分散管理层对业务的注意力。 鉴于公司对CEO领导力的高度依赖，英伟达仍面临关键人物风险，同时存在更广泛的公司治理担忧。
items.title_en: Moody's: Nvidia's rating and outlook remain unchanged.
items.body_en: The Aa1 rating and stable outlook reflect Nvidia's exceptionally strong competitive and financial position. The return of Nvidia's CEO has restored strategic continuity, but some governance issues remain unresolved. Nvidia's rating and stable outlook also take into account the potential impact of new export control rules on sales of advanced semiconductors. Nvidia continues to face high levels of regulatory and government scrutiny, which may divert management's attention away from the business. Given the company's high dependence on CEO leadership, Nvidia still faces key person risk, along with broader corporate governance concerns.

items.title_zh: 美联储：11月美国垃圾债市场压力激增
items.body_zh: 根据美国纽约联储一项指数，11月份美国高收益债务市场的压力飙升至一年多来的最高水平。企业债市场困境指数中的高收益子指数成分本月升至2025年5月以来的最高水平，其高收益成分从10月底的0.15升至0.22。上周，信用利差触及约3.69个百分点，创下2025年5月以来的最高水平，原因是市场对AI交易及AI驱动增长的可持续性的怀疑动摇了风险资产。
items.title_en: The Federal Reserve: Pressure on the U.S. junk bond market surged in November.
items.body_en: According to an index from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, stress in the U.S. high-yield debt market surged to its highest level in over a year in November. The high-yield sub-index component of the Corporate Bond Market Stress Index rose to its highest level since May 2025 this month, with its high-yield component increasing from 0.15 at the end of October to 0.22. Last week, credit spreads reached approximately 3.69 percentage points, the highest level since May 2025, as market skepticism about the sustainability of AI trading and AI-driven growth shook risk assets.

items.title_zh: 剑指最大生产国巴西：美国拟对食糖进口实施严厉打压
items.body_zh: 特朗普政府提议大幅提高不受长期配额制度约束的食糖关税，这是旨在惩罚最大生产国巴西的一系列举措的一部分。 美国贸易代表办公室（USTR）周三提议，对配额外原糖征收每公斤44美分的关税，对配额外精制糖征收每公斤60美分的关税。尽管这些收费主要针对巴西，但该提案还提出将这些关税适用于所有国家，这是一场出乎意料的全面打压行动。
items.title_en: Targeting Brazil, the largest sugar-producing country: The United States plans to impose strict restrictions on sugar imports.
items.body_en: The Trump administration has proposed a significant increase in tariffs on sugar not subject to the long-standing quota system, as part of a series of measures aimed at penalizing Brazil, the largest producer. On Wednesday, the U.S. Trade Representative's Office (USTR) proposed a tariff of 44 cents per kilogram on out-of-quota raw sugar and 60 cents per kilogram on out-of-quota refined sugar. Although these tariffs are primarily aimed at Brazil, the proposal also suggests applying them to all countries, representing an unexpected and sweeping crackdown.

items.title_zh: 俄副外长：俄方愿继续举行俄美乌三方会谈
items.body_zh: 俄罗斯外交部副部长里亚布科夫表示，俄方愿继续以俄美乌三方模式就乌克兰问题举行会谈。他表示，三方谈判没有被束之高阁，也没有被冻结。但截至目前，下一轮谈判的前景仍不明朗。里亚布科夫还表示，俄美将就双方间敏感问题在今年年底前举行沟通。（央视）
items.title_en: Russian Deputy Foreign Minister: Russia is willing to continue holding trilateral talks between Russia, the United States, and Ukraine.
items.body_en: Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Ryabkov stated that Russia is willing to continue holding talks on the Ukraine issue in a trilateral format involving Russia, the United States, and Ukraine. He stated that the trilateral talks have not been shelved or frozen. However, as of now, the prospects for the next round of negotiations remain uncertain. Ryabkov also stated that Russia and the United States will hold discussions on sensitive issues between the two countries before the end of this year. (CCTV).

items.title_zh: 黄金储备公司对委内瑞拉认定Siembra Minera为该国最具战略价值矿业
items.body_zh: 黄金储备公司对委内瑞拉认定Siembra Minera为该国最具战略价值矿业资产之一表示欢迎。 确认已准备好重启运营并解决未决索赔事项。
items.title_en: Venezuela's Gold Reserves Corporation recognizes Siembra Minera as the country's most strategically valuable mining company.
items.body_en: The Gold Reserve Corporation welcomes Venezuela's recognition of Siembra Minera as one of the country's most strategically valuable mining assets. Confirm readiness to resume operations and resolve outstanding claims.

items.title_zh: 周三（11月25日），美股行业ETF全球科技股指数ETF收跌1.03%，半导
items.body_zh: 周三（11月25日），美股行业ETF全球科技股指数ETF收跌1.03%，半导体ETF跌1.01%，全球航空业ETF跌0.88%，科技行业ETF跌0.83%，金融业ETF、能源业ETF至多涨0.74%，工业指数ETF涨0.83%。
items.title_en: On Wednesday (November 25), the U.S. stock sector ETF Global Technology Stock Index ETF closed down 1.03%, and the semiconductor.
items.body_en: On Wednesday (November 25), the U.S. sector ETFs saw the Global Technology ETF close down 1.03%, the Semiconductor ETF down 1.01%, the Global Airlines ETF down 0.88%, and the Technology Sector ETF down 0.83%. The Financial Sector ETF and the Energy Sector ETF rose by up to 0.74%, while the Industrial Index ETF rose by 0.83%.

items.title_zh: 随着交易进入新周期，美国芝加哥柴油价格大幅下跌
items.body_zh: 交易员表示，随着区域管道的交易过渡到12月首个月度交货周期，周三美国芝加哥现货市场的柴油现货升贴水（Cash differentials）下滑，而汽油价格上涨。 市场参与者称，芝加哥超低硫柴油下跌15美分，交易价格较纽约商业交易所（NYMEX）超低硫柴油期货合约低40美分/加仑。 芝加哥CBOB汽油上涨5美分，交易价格较NYMEX汽油期货基准低18美分/加仑。
items.title_en: As trading enters a new cycle, U.S. Chicago diesel prices have fallen sharply.
items.body_en: Traders reported that as regional pipeline trades transitioned to the first monthly delivery cycle in December, diesel cash differentials in the U.S. Chicago spot market declined on Wednesday, while gasoline prices rose. Market participants reported that Chicago ultra-low sulfur diesel fell by 15 cents, trading at a 40-cent-per-gallon discount to the New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) ultra-low sulfur diesel futures contract. Chicago CBOB gasoline rose by 5 cents, trading at 18 cents/gallon below the NYMEX gasoline futures benchmark.

story.title_zh: 把银行家锁进书房，直到他们答应救市
story.title_en: The Night He Locked the Bankers In
story.body_zh: 一九〇七年十月纽约股市崩盘，没有央行兜底的美国眼看滑向恐慌。六十九岁的摩根把几十位银行总裁锁进书房，逼出两千五百万美元救市资金，凌晨签下协议，恐慌停了。五年后美联储成立。
story.body_en: In October nineteen oh seven, New York was in panic. America had no central bank. J.P. Morgan, sixty-nine years old, summoned bank presidents to his library and locked the doors. The deal was signed after midnight. The panic stopped. Five years later, the Federal Reserve was born.

lines.en: New York, October, nineteen oh seven. Depositors are lining up in the streets. America has no central bank, and the panic is spreading.
lines.zh: 纽约，1907 年 10 月。储户在街头排起长队。美国没有央行，恐慌正在蔓延。

lines.en: So the most powerful banker in America did something nobody would dare today.
lines.zh: 于是，全美最有权势的银行家做了一件今天没人敢做的事。

lines.en: Gentlemen, you will all come to my library tonight. Bring your real numbers, not the ones for newspapers.
lines.zh: 诸位，今晚都到我的书房来。带上真实的账目，别带给报纸看的那份。

lines.en: He questioned each president one by one, behind closed doors, until the true holes were on the table.
lines.zh: 他关门一个个逼问各位总裁，直到真实的窟窿全部摆上桌面。

lines.en: It is almost twelve o'clock. Nobody leaves this room until the papers are signed.
lines.zh: 现在快十二点了。文件不签完，谁也别想出这个门。

lines.en: After midnight, twenty-five million dollars was pledged. The panic stopped. Five years later, partly because of this night, the Federal Reserve was born.
lines.zh: 午夜过后，两千五百万美元的救市资金凑齐了。恐慌停了。五年后，正因为这一夜，美联储诞生了。

joke.title_zh: 擦鞋童都在荐股的那天，他清仓离场
joke.title_en: When the Shoeshine Boy Gave Stock Tips
joke.body_zh: 一九二九年，约瑟夫·肯尼迪让擦鞋童擦鞋，小孩却热心地给他推荐起股票来。他回到办公室立刻清仓。他的逻辑是：连擦鞋童都在荐股，说明最后一批买家已经进场，接下来只有卖盘了。没过多久，大崩盘来了。这个观察后来被称为擦鞋童理论：当所有人都在谈论某样东西时，往往意味着它已经不便宜了。
joke.body_en: New York, nineteen twenty-nine. Joseph Kennedy got his shoes polished, and the shoeshine boy happily gave him stock tips. Kennedy walked back to his office and sold everything. His logic was sharp. If the shoeshine boy is giving stock tips, the last buyers have already arrived. Who is left to buy? Soon after, the market crashed. People still call it the shoeshine boy theory. When everybody talks about something, it is usually no longer cheap.

items.body_en: Concerns over AI trading persist, with chip stocks leading the decline in the Nasdaq. The Dow Jones rose 0.8%, Anthropic's share price fell below its IPO price, and metals generally declined. At his first all-hands meeting since his reinstatement, Jensen Huang apologized and admitted to violating Nvidia's Code of Conduct, but still rejected the traditional succession plan. Anthropic's share price fell as much as 14% below its IPO price, and its founders cashed out over $560 million. Dell raised its full-year revenue guidance for AI-optimized servers from $74 billion to $78 billion. The backlog of AI server orders in the third quarter amounted to $132.3 billion, and the share price rose 4% after the bell.

items.title_en: Federal Reserve October Discount Rate Meeting Minutes: Eight Regional Fed Banks Recommend Raising the Discount Rate.
items.body_en: The Federal Reserve's discount rate meeting minutes, released on Tuesday local time, showed that prior to the October Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting, the boards of directors of 8 out of 12 regional Federal Reserve Banks had recommended raising the discount rate from 4% to 4.25%. These included the Federal Reserve Banks of Boston, Cleveland, Chicago, St. Louis, Minneapolis, Richmond, Kansas City, and Dallas. Among them, the boards of the Federal Reserve Banks of Richmond, Kansas City, and Dallas initially supported keeping interest rates unchanged on October 8, but then shifted to supporting a rate hike on October 22. The Federal Reserve Board ultimately approved keeping the discount rate at 4% on two occasions.

items.title_zh: 四季度以来A股回购增持计划金额接近千亿元，注销式回购渐成常态

items.title_en: Since the fourth quarter, the amount of A-share buyback and increase in holdings plans has approached RMB 100 billion, and cancellation-type share buybacks have gradually become the norm.
items.body_en: Share buybacks by A-share listed companies and increased holdings by major shareholders continue to gain momentum. According to data from Tonghuashun iFinD, since the fourth quarter, based on the announcement date of the board of directors' proposal, a total of 303 new share buyback plans have been added, with a total proposed share buyback amount of approximately RMB 72.5 billion (calculated based on the maximum amount); 242 new instances of major shareholders increasing their holdings have been added, with a total proposed increase in holdings of approximately RMB 23.4 billion (calculated based on the maximum amount). Data shows that as of November, the popularity of cancellation-type share buybacks by A-share companies has not waned. A total of 46 companies have disclosed cancellation-type share buyback plans, with a total proposed buyback amount of approximately RMB 9.7 billion (calculated based on the maximum amount). (Securities Daily).

items.title_en: Latin American currencies and stock markets generally declined, with the Colombian peso leading the drop.
items.body_en: Most Latin American currencies and stock markets are down, with the Colombian peso leading the decline. Concerns about the country's fiscal outlook have severely impacted the local currency's exchange rate. Meanwhile, buoyed by optimism over fiscal consolidation, Brazilian assets are expected to end their three-day losing streak. With the exception of the Colombian peso, all major currencies in the region are expected to record significant annual declines this year, and the MSCI Latin America Equity Benchmark Index is also expected to see a cumulative decline of 5% this year. The Colombian peso is currently down 3%, falling below the 3,600 pesos to 1 U.S. dollar mark for the first time since June this year, and is likely to decline for the fifth consecutive trading day.

story.title_zh: 从每周一美元二毛，到钢铁大王
story.title_en: From a Dollar Twenty a Week to Steel
story.body_zh: 卡内基十三岁移民美国，第一份工每周挣一美元二毛。当电报信童时，他背下全城商户的名字和脸。二十几岁把全部身家压进钢铁，建成世界最大钢铁厂。晚年捐出九成财产。
story.body_en: Andrew Carnegie arrived in America from Scotland at thirteen. His first job paid one dollar and twenty cents a week. As a messenger boy, he memorized every business in town. In his thirties he bet everything on steel, built the largest steel company in the world, then gave away ninety percent of it.

lines.en: Pittsburgh, eighteen fifty. A thirteen year old Scottish immigrant starts his first job. It pays one dollar and twenty cents a week.
lines.zh: 匹兹堡，1850 年。一个十三岁的苏格兰移民开始第一份工作，周薪一美元二毛。

lines.en: Boy, the telegraph office needs a messenger. Can you learn the streets?
lines.zh: 小子，电报局要个信童。你能把街巷记熟吗？

lines.en: I will learn more than the streets, sir. I will learn every business in town, and every face behind the door.
lines.zh: 先生，我记的不只是街巷。我要记住全城每一家商户，和每扇门后面的每张脸。

lines.en: While other boys played, he drilled himself on the telegraph key, and became the fastest ear in the city.
lines.zh: 别的孩子去玩了，他对着电报机日夜苦练，成了全城收发电报最快的人。

lines.en: Save it, invest it early, and when you find your industry, bet everything on it.
lines.zh: 把钱存下来，早一点投出去。找到属于自己的行业时，就把全部身家押上去。

lines.en: He built the largest steel company in the world. Then he gave ninety percent of it away, with one line for the history books. Dying rich is a disgrace.
lines.zh: 他建成了世界最大的钢铁公司，然后捐出了九成财产，只留给历史一句话：带着巨富死去，是一种耻辱。

joke.title_zh: 我是靠卖得太早赚的钱
joke.title_en: I Made My Fortune by Selling Too Early
joke.body_zh: 罗斯柴尔德家族的男爵说过一句反直觉的话：我是靠卖得太早，才赚到钱的。人人都怕卖早了少赚，可他偏偏说卖早是美德。背后的道理是：没人能卖在最高点，总想赚最后一分钱的人，往往连本带利还回去。留给读者一个问题：你手里的盈利，是因为贪心多等了几天，还是因为纪律提前落袋？
joke.body_en: Baron Rothschild said something that sounds backwards. I made my fortune by selling too early. Everyone fears selling too soon and missing the top. He called selling early a virtue. The logic is simple. Nobody sells at the exact peak. People who chase the last penny usually return everything, and more. So here is a question worth thinking about. Your last winning trade. Did you hold longer out of greed, or exit early out of discipline?

items.title_zh: AI芯片供应链收紧，国产超节点迎发展机遇窗口
items.body_zh: 近日，三星开始穿透严查代工的传闻流出。向国内晶圆代工厂、芯片设计公司等多方求证获悉，该传闻并不准确，但传闻背后，是美国商务部工业和安全局（BIS）于11月16日出台新规带来的滥用出口管制。多位业内人士表示，海外流片通道进一步收紧的态势下，国产AI供应链建设势在必行。在制程技术落后于海外先进厂商的情况下，超节点有望弥补单芯片算力短板，并将迎来发展的机遇窗口。（上证报）
items.title_en: The AI chip supply chain is tightening, and domestic supernodes are facing a window of opportunity for development.
items.body_en: Recently, rumors have emerged that Samsung has begun to thoroughly investigate its foundry operations. After seeking confirmation from various parties, including domestic wafer foundries and chip design companies, it was learned that the rumor is not accurate. However, behind the rumor is the abuse of export controls resulting from the new regulations issued by the U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) of the Department of Commerce on November 16. Several industry insiders have stated that, given the further tightening of overseas wafer fabrication channels, the development of a domestic AI supply chain is imperative. Given that process technology lags behind that of leading overseas manufacturers, supernodes are expected to compensate for the shortcomings in single-chip computing power and will usher in a window of opportunity for development. (Shanghai Securities News).

items.title_zh: 报道：美联储监察长调查理事鲍曼是否违反沟通规则
items.body_zh: 美联储内部监察机构正在调查美联储理事米歇尔·鲍曼（Michelle Bowman）出席美国银行举办的一场私人晚宴时，是否违反了该央行（与联邦公开市场委员会FOMC货币政策会议相关）的“静默期”限制。 这场晚宴发生在纽约，时间是在美联储一次政策会议召开数小时后，当时官员们仍被禁止向公众就经济或货币政策发表评论。鲍曼否认自己违反了美联储的内部限制规定，她表示自己一直遵守所有适用规则，并将继续坚定恪守。（彭博）
items.title_en: Report: The Federal Reserve's Inspector General is investigating whether Governor Bowman violated communication rules.
items.body_en: The Federal Reserve's internal watchdog is investigating whether Federal Reserve Governor Michelle Bowman violated the PBOC's (related to the Federal Open Market Committee's FOMC monetary policy meetings) "quiet period" restrictions when she attended a private dinner hosted by Bank of America. The dinner took place in New York just hours after a Federal Reserve policy meeting, when officials were still prohibited from commenting publicly on economic or monetary policy. Bowman denies violating the Federal Reserve's internal restrictions, stating that she has always complied with all applicable rules and will continue to do so with unwavering commitment. (Bloomberg).

items.title_zh: 券商密集披露增持回购进展，“真金白银”稳市场预期
items.body_zh: 近日，长江证券、东吴证券、国联民生、中泰证券、红塔证券5家上市券商集中披露控股股东增持或股份回购最新进展，以“真金白银”向市场传递稳预期信号。在业内人士看来，当前券商板块估值已处于历史低位，叠加稳市政策密集落地，建议把握政策催化下的估值修复机会，重点关注资本实力与业务能力较强的头部券商。（中证报）
items.title_en: Brokerages frequently disclose progress on share buybacks, with "real money" stabilizing market expectations.
items.body_en: Recently, five listed brokerages – Yangtze River Securities, Soochow Securities, Guolian Minsheng Securities, Zhongtai Securities, and Hongta Securities – have collectively disclosed the latest developments regarding their controlling shareholders' increased shareholdings or share buybacks, sending a clear signal of stable expectations to the market with "real money." In the view of industry insiders, the current valuations of the securities sector are at historical lows. Coupled with the intensive implementation of market stabilization policies, it is recommended to seize the opportunity for valuation recovery catalyzed by these policies, with a focus on leading securities firms with strong capital strength and business capabilities. (China Securities Journal).

items.title_zh: 一纸承诺函“贷”动超200亿元回购增持潮
items.body_zh: “这段时间我们重新梳理、排查了辖区内的上市公司客户，积极接洽客户及其主要股东在股票回购、增持方面的需求，尽可能简化业务流程，匹配客户的用款节奏。”一家股份行深圳分行相关业务负责人告诉记者。一纸《贷款承诺函》，正化作支持A股上市公司市值管理的“真金白银”。11月1日以来，已有111家上市公司披露相关主体拟获得银行专项贷款，额度合计229.56亿元，无论是公司数量还是贷款规模，均远超今年此前单月水平。
items.title_en: A letter of commitment "drives" A-shares buyback and increase in holdings wave of over RMB 20 billion.
items.body_en: "During this period, we have re-examined and screened our listed company clients within our jurisdiction, proactively engaging with clients and their major shareholders regarding their needs for share buybacks and increased shareholdings. We have simplified business processes as much as possible to align with clients' funding requirements."The head of relevant business at the Shenzhen branch of a joint-stock bank told reporters. A "Loan Commitment Letter" is being transformed into "hard cash" to support the market capitalization management of A-share listed companies. Since November 1, 111 listed companies have disclosed that relevant entities plan to obtain special bank loans, with a total amount of 22.956 billion yuan. Both the number of companies and the size of the loans far exceed the levels seen in any previous month this year.

items.title_zh: 美联储高官遭内部调查：监管副主席鲍曼被指违反“静默期”规定
items.body_zh: 美联储监察长办公室（OIG）正在对美联储负责金融监管的副主席米歇尔·鲍曼（Michelle Bowman）展开调查，核实她是否因在2026年6月出席一场华尔街私人晚宴而违反了央行的沟通...
items.title_en: Federal Reserve senior official under internal investigation: Vice Chair for Supervision Bowman accused of violating "quiet period" rules.
items.body_en: The Federal Reserve's Office of the Inspector General (OIG) is investigating Michelle Bowman, the Federal Reserve's Vice Chair for Financial Supervision, to determine whether she violated the Federal Reserve's communication policies by attending a private Wall Street dinner in June 2023...

items.title_zh: 随着美联储加息预期升温，新兴市场债券ETF录得创纪录资金外流
items.body_zh: 随着美联储可能加息的前景抑制了整个发展中世界的风险偏好，投资者正纷纷从购买新兴市场债券的交易所交易基金（ETF）中撤资。上周，贝莱德旗下的iShares摩根大通美元新兴市场债券ETF录得超过1.35亿美元的资金流出。这标志着该基金连续第二周出现资金外流，累计流出总额达4.37亿美元，抹平了11月初录得的资金流入。
items.title_en: Emerging market bond ETFs recorded record outflows as expectations of Federal Reserve rate hikes intensified.
items.body_en: As the prospect of potential interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve dampens risk appetite across the developing world, investors are withdrawing funds from exchange-traded funds (ETFs) that invest in emerging market bonds. Last week, BlackRock's iShares JPMorgan USD Emerging Markets Bond ETF recorded outflows of over $135 million. This marks the second consecutive week of outflows from the fund, with a cumulative total of $437 million, offsetting the inflows recorded in early November.

items.title_zh: 马斯克承认AI研发落后对手
items.body_zh: 据报道，SpaceX首席执行官埃隆・马斯克近日向员工表示，公司在人工智能（AI）研发方面正落后于Anthropic、OpenAI等竞争对手，因此，与其将数据中心算力全部用于自研AI产品，不如出租给竞争对手，以获得更高的商业回报。三名知情人士称，SpaceX自5月以来一直向Anthropic、谷歌等企业出租数据中心算力，相关业务每月可带来数十亿美元收入。
items.title_en: Musk acknowledges that AI development is lagging behind competitors.
items.body_en: According to reports, SpaceX CEO Elon Musk recently told employees that the company is lagging behind competitors such as Anthropic and OpenAI in terms of artificial intelligence (AI) research and development. Therefore, instead of allocating all of the data center's computing power to its own AI products, it would be better to lease it to competitors to achieve higher commercial returns. According to three sources familiar with the matter, SpaceX has been leasing data center computing power to companies such as Anthropic and Google since May, and the related business can generate billions of dollars in revenue each month.

items.title_zh: 国际金价涨超2.6%，美股开盘时逼近3700美元
items.body_zh: 周一（11月23日）纽约尾盘，现货黄金涨2.66%，报3632.53美元/盎司，全天处于上涨状态，整体震荡上行，北京时间22:30刷新日高至3689.94美元，之后回吐部分涨幅。 现货白银涨4.77%，报43.0794美元/盎司。 COMEX铜期货涨2.09%，报5.6890美元/磅，在一波短线拉升行情中、22:32达到5.8775美元。
items.title_en: International gold prices rise by over 2.6%, approaching $3,700 at the opening of U.S. stock markets.
items.body_en: At the New York close on Monday (November 23), spot gold rose by 2.66% to $3,632.53/oz. It was in an uptrend throughout the day, with an overall volatile upward movement. At 22:30 Beijing time, it hit a new intraday high of $3,689.94, before giving back some of the gains. Spot silver rose by 4.77% to $43.0794/oz. COMEX copper futures rose by 2.09% to $5.6890/lb, reaching $5.8775 at 22:32 during a short-term rally.

items.title_zh: 胜宏科技于11月23日斥资103.4万元回购9000股A股
items.body_zh: 胜宏科技（02476）发布公告，于2026年11月23日斥资103.4万元回购9000股A股。

items.title_zh: 频现增持信号，产业资本“纠偏”REITs定价
items.body_zh: 公募REITs市场近期正释放积极信号。11月以来，汇添富、博时、南方等多家基金公司密集披露公告，旗下REITs的原始权益人拟逆势增持份额。部分业内人士认为，本轮产业资本的“增持潮”是二级市场回调背景下的定价纠偏，叠加锁仓承诺、集团层面参与等安排，信号“含金量”在提升。（上证报）
items.title_en: Frequent signals of increased holdings, industrial capital "corrects" REITs pricing.
items.body_en: The publicly offered REITs market has been sending positive signals recently. Since November, several fund companies, including Harvest Fund Management, Bosera Asset Management, and China Southern Asset Management, have frequently issued announcements stating that the original equity holders of their REITs intend to increase their holdings against the current trend. Some industry insiders believe that this round of "buying spree" by industrial capital is a pricing correction against the backdrop of a pullback in the secondary market. Coupled with arrangements such as lock-up commitments and participation at the group level, the "substance" of the signal is increasing. (Shanghai Securities News).

items.title_zh: 美国财长贝森特
items.body_zh: 金融机构往往是阻止与伊朗政权有关联的资金进入美国经济的第一道防线。 财政部将继续切断该政权赖以资助其军事、武器项目和恐怖代理人的资金生命线。
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent.
items.body_en: Financial institutions are often the first line of defense in preventing funds linked to the Iranian regime from entering the U.S. economy. The Department of the Treasury will continue to cut off the financial lifelines that the regime relies on to fund its military, weapons programs, and terrorist proxies.

items.title_zh: 黄仁勋复职点燃科技债务反弹，信贷投资者“神经紧绷”
items.body_zh: 全球公司债市场大幅反弹，美国恐慌指标创下数月来最大改善幅度。在英伟达董事会恢复黄仁勋的首席执行官职务后，科技公司债券出现强劲反弹。 CDX投资级指数利差录得4月8日以来最大的盘中跌幅，欧洲高评级和垃圾债指标也同步走低。 所谓“人工智能交易”中的主要标的同样迎来大涨，云计算提供商CoreWeave Inc.的债券攀升，超大规模云服务商甲骨文的相关信贷指标也大幅收紧。
items.title_en: Jensen Huang's reinstatement sparks a rebound in tech debt, leaving credit investors "on edge"
items.body_en: The global corporate bond market has rebounded sharply, with the U.S. fear gauge recording its largest improvement in months. Tech company bonds rebounded strongly after Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO. The CDX Investment Grade Index spread recorded its largest intraday decline since April 8, and European high-grade and junk bond indicators also fell in tandem. The main targets in the so-called "AI trade" also saw significant gains, with bonds from cloud computing provider CoreWeave Inc.Bonds rose, and the relevant credit indicators of the hyperscale cloud service provider Oracle also tightened significantly.

items.title_zh: 标普500指数的11个板块中，信息技术/科技板块收涨9.03%，电信板块涨5
items.body_zh: 标普500指数的11个板块中，信息技术/科技板块收涨9.03%，电信板块涨5.18%，可选消费板块涨4.27%，能源板块跌1.32%。 在科技板块，成分股英伟达收涨超31%领跑，戴尔科技涨超20.4%，美光科技涨19%表现第三，迈威尔科技、Lumentum、惠与（HPE）、MPWR、英特尔、高意公司Coherent、科磊至少涨超14.9%进入涨幅前十，ROP则收跌0.37%，CrowdStrike跌超8.95.
items.title_en: Among the 11 sectors of the S&P 500 Index, the Information Technology/Technology sector rose by 9.03%, and the Telecommunications sector rose by 5%.
items.body_en: Among the 11 sectors of the S&P 500 Index, the Information Technology/Technology sector closed up 9.03%, the Telecommunications sector rose 5.18%, the Consumer Discretionary sector rose 4.27%, and the Energy sector fell 1.32%. In the Technology sector, constituent stock Nvidia led the way with a gain of over 31%, Dell Technologies rose by over 20.4%, and Micron Technology ranked third with a gain of 19%. Marvell Technology, Lumentum, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), MPWR, Intel, Coherent, and KLA all rose by at least 14.9%, entering the top ten in terms of gains. ROP closed down 0.37%, and CrowdStrike fell by over 8.95%.

items.title_zh: 高盛：美元明年将“温和走弱”
items.body_zh: 高盛集团全球外汇和利率预测主管Kamakshya Trivedi表示，随着利率上升进一步推高该货币，美元涨势具有持续性，随后将在明年“温和”走弱。 Trivedi认为处于紧缩模式的美联储将在未来几个月内支撑美元，进而对经济增长和新兴市场货币造成压力。 “当你看到由利率驱动的金融条件收紧时，美元往往在这种环境下表现良好。美元仍有余勇可贾（仍有上行动能）。
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs: The U.S. dollar will "weaken moderately" next year.
items.body_en: Kamakshya Trivedi, Goldman Sachs Group's head of global foreign exchange and interest rate forecasting, said that the U.S. dollar's rally will be sustained as rising interest rates further boost the currency, followed by a "moderate" weakening next year. Trivedi believes that the Federal Reserve, which is in tightening mode, will support the U.S. dollar in the coming months, putting pressure on economic growth and emerging market currencies. “When you see financial conditions tightening driven by interest rates, the U.S. dollar tends to perform well in this environment. The U.S. dollar still has room to run (still has upward momentum).

items.title_zh: 美国参议院Warner
items.body_zh: 总统特朗普插手企业事务的做法令人难以接受。 特朗普应当聚焦美国国家安全事务，而不是英伟达。（新浪）
items.title_en: U.S. Senator Warner.

story.title_zh: 不读财报的调研法：去和对手闲聊
story.body_zh: 费雪调研公司有个怪招：不急着看报表，先去闲聊。找离职员工、供应商、同行工程师，一家公司的真实成色就浮出来了。他管这叫闲聊法，靠它拿了摩托罗拉十多年。
story.body_en: Philip Fisher had an odd way to research a company. Before reading reports, he went out and chatted. Former employees, salesmen, suppliers, rival engineers. From these talks, the truth surfaced. He called it the scuttlebutt method.

lines.en: California, nineteen fifty. While other analysts read annual reports, Philip Fisher does something strange. He goes out for coffee, and small talk.
lines.zh: 加州，1950 年。别的分析师在读年报，菲利普·费雪却在干一件怪事：出门喝咖啡、闲聊。

lines.en: You used to work at their plant. Was the new product real quality, or just a good story?
lines.zh: 你以前在他们的厂里干过。新品是真有实力，还是故事讲得好？

lines.en: Honestly? The lab is serious. But the boss loses his temper, and good people keep leaving.
lines.zh: 说实话？实验室是认真的。但老板脾气大，能干的人一直在走。

lines.en: And the competitors say the same thing, from the other side. Now the picture is complete.
lines.zh: 竞争对手从另一头说出来的，也是同样的话。拼图这就完整了。

lines.en: He called it the scuttlebutt method. It led him to hold Motorola for decades. His advice shaped Buffett too. If it is a wonderful company, almost never sell.
lines.zh: 他管这叫闲聊法。靠它，他拿住了摩托罗拉十多年。这条建议也影响了巴菲特：真正的好公司，几乎永远别卖。

joke.title_zh: 过去五次衰退，经济学家预测中了九次
joke.title_en: Nine of the Last Five Recessions
joke.body_zh: 经济学家萨缪尔森讲过一个流传至今的玩笑：股市在过去五次衰退里，预测中了九次。意思是股市总在喊狼来了，喊的次数远比狼真的来的次数多。所以听到谁信誓旦旦地预测崩盘，不用太紧张，也不用太得意，先数一数他之前喊过几次。预测市场这件事，连最聪明的人也常常只是运气好。
joke.body_en: The economist Paul Samuelson left us a joke that never gets old. The stock market has predicted nine of the last five recessions. Read that again. Nine predictions. Five real recessions. The market cries wolf far more often than the wolf arrives. So when someone loudly predicts the next crash, stay calm. Count how many times they called it before. Predicting the market is hard. Even for the smartest people in the room.

items.title_zh: 专家：资金面扰动有限 流动性平稳跨月可期
items.body_zh: Wind数据显示，本周（11月23日—11月27日）央行公开市场有3795亿元隔夜逆回购到期，另有10000亿元MLF到期，两项合计13795亿元。受访专家普遍认为，临近跨月时点，央行将继续灵活运用各类公开市场操作工具，呵护流动性充裕，防范资金面出现较大波动。
items.title_en: Expert: Limited disruption on the funding front, stable liquidity expected to continue into the next month.
items.body_en: According to Wind data, this week (November 23–November 27), RMB 379.5 billion in overnight reverse share buybacks matured in the PBOC's open market, and an additional RMB 1 trillion in MLFs matured, totaling RMB 1.3795 trillion. The experts interviewed generally believe that as the end of the month approaches, the PBOC will continue to flexibly utilize various open market operation tools to maintain ample liquidity and prevent significant fluctuations in the money market.

items.title_zh: 交易员不再充分消化美联储12月加息的情景
items.body_zh: 标普500指数跌3.1%，纳斯达克100指数跌4.9%，纳指跌4.6%，半导体指数跌10%，Anthropic维持大约10%的跌幅。 英伟达跌11.79%，闪迪跌16%，博通跌12.58%，美光跌13.22%，英特尔跌6.13%，AMD跌13.59%，高通跌5.29%，台积电跌9.30%，阿斯麦跌6.70%。 VIX波动率日内涨幅达22.5%，报34.85。 美国2-7年期国债收益率至少跌15个基点。
items.title_en: Traders are no longer fully factoring in the scenario of a Federal Reserve rate hike in December.
items.body_en: The S&P 500 Index fell by 3.1%, the Nasdaq 100 Index fell by 4.9%, the Nasdaq Composite Index fell by 4.6%, the Semiconductor Index fell by 10%, and Anthropic maintained a decline of approximately 10%. Nvidia fell 11.79%, SanDisk fell 16%, Broadcom fell 12.58%, Micron fell 13.22%, Intel fell 6.13%, AMD fell 13.59%, Qualcomm fell 5.29%, TSMC fell 9.30%, and ASML fell 6.70%. The VIX volatility index rose by 22.5% intraday, closing at 34.85. U.S. Treasury yields for 2- to 7-year maturities fell by at least 15 basis points.

items.title_zh: 回购增持密集落地，一年多次分红成常态，A股市场投融资生态加速转变
items.body_zh: 从大额分红承诺到密集回购增持，上市公司以“真金白银”回馈投资者的动作持续不断。权威数据显示：今年四季度以来，沪深上市公司共新增披露334单回购计划，预计回购金额上限超过700亿元，新增披露近1200单回购进展；新增控股股东、实际控制人、董事、高管增持计划109单，预计增持金额上限近200亿元，新增披露股东增持进展近300单。
items.title_en: Share buybacks are being implemented at an accelerated pace, and multiple dividend distributions within a year have become the norm. The investment and financing landscape of the A-share market is undergoing rapid transformation.
items.body_en: From substantial dividend commitments to intensive share buyback programs, listed companies continue to reward investors with "hard cash." According to authoritative data, since the fourth quarter of this year, listed companies on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges have disclosed a total of 334 new share buyback plans, with an estimated maximum buyback amount exceeding RMB 70 billion. Additionally, nearly 1,200 new share buyback progress updates have been disclosed. Furthermore, 109 new shareholding increase plans by controlling shareholders, actual controllers, directors, and executives have been announced, with an estimated maximum increase amount of nearly RMB 20 billion. Lastly, nearly 300 new shareholder shareholding increase progress updates have been disclosed.

items.title_zh: 强势美元“冲击波”再起
items.body_zh: 强势美元“冲击波”再起 ◎记者 黄冰玉 多重利好共振之下，美元汇率“水涨船高”。 本轮走强既体现了美联储加息预期的内生定价逻辑，也反映了AI资本开支热潮与美国经济韧性正吸...
items.title_en: The "shock wave" of a strong U.S. dollar strikes again.
items.body_en: The "shockwave" of a strong U.S. dollar is rising again ◎ Reporter Huang Bingyu Under the combined effect of multiple favorable factors, the U.S. dollar exchange rate is "rising with the tide." This round of strengthening not only reflects the endogenous pricing logic of the Federal Reserve's interest rate hike expectations, but also reflects the fact that the AI capital expenditure boom and the resilience of the U.S. economy are attracting...

items.title_zh: 欧洲股市创2025年以来最大周跌幅，科技股重挫
items.body_zh: 随着市场对人工智能（AI）热潮能否持续的疑虑再度升温，从股票到铜等全球资产均受到冲击，欧洲股市录得2025年4月以来最大单周跌幅。 斯托克欧洲600指数收盘下跌2%，本周累计跌幅扩大至5.8%。科技分类指数本周重挫11%，创2020年3月以来最大单周跌幅。随着铜和黄金价格下跌，矿业股也走低。 投资者转而买入个人护理、食品和医疗保健等更具防御性的板块。
items.title_en: European stock markets experience their largest weekly decline since 2025, with tech stocks taking a significant hit.
items.body_en: As market doubts about the sustainability of the artificial intelligence (AI) boom resurface, global assets ranging from stocks to copper have been impacted, with European stock markets recording their largest weekly decline since April 2025. The STOXX Europe 600 Index closed down 2%, bringing its cumulative decline for the week to 5.8%. The technology sector index plummeted by 11% this week, marking its largest weekly decline since March 2020. As copper and gold prices fell, mining stocks also declined. Investors have shifted to buying more defensive sectors such as personal care, food, and healthcare.

items.title_zh: 欧盟与印尼签署贸易和投资协定
items.body_zh: 欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩称，欧盟与印度尼西亚（印尼）签署了综合性经济合作伙伴协议与投资保护协议，以期促进贸易与投资。 欧盟委员会在一份新闻稿中表示，协议取消了欧盟商品出口到印尼的98.5%税目项下的进口关税。这两项协议现在都需要欧洲议会的批准。 印尼当局也在进行其内部的批准程序。
items.title_en: EU and Indonesia Sign Trade and Investment Agreement.
items.body_en: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen stated that the European Union (EU) and Indonesia have signed a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement and an Investment Protection Agreement with the aim of promoting trade and investment. In a press release, the European Commission stated that the agreement eliminates import tariffs on 98.5% of tariff lines for EU goods exported to Indonesia. Both agreements now require approval from the European Parliament. The Indonesian authorities are also undergoing their internal approval process.

items.title_zh: 美股七巨头收盘播报｜周五（11月20日），美国科技股七巨头（Magnific
items.body_zh: 美股七巨头收盘播报｜周五（11月20日），美国科技股七巨头（Magnificent 7）指数跌5.01%，报194.71点，本周累计下跌10.28%，11月16-18日维持小幅下跌，19日（Anthropic美国IPO首日）以来持续扩大跌幅。 英伟达收盘重挫14%，创2025年1月份以来最大单日跌幅；本周重挫23%，创2008年10月份以来最大单周跌幅。
items.title_en: Closing Report on the U.S. Magnificent Seven Stocks | On Friday (November 20), the U.S. Magnificent Seven tech stocks.
items.body_en: U.S. Magnificent 7 Closing Report｜On Friday (November 20), the U.S. Magnificent 7 tech stocks index fell 5.01% to 194.71 points, with a cumulative decline of 10.28% this week. It remained slightly down from November 16–18 and has continued to widen its decline since November 19 (the first day of Anthropic's U.S. IPO). Nvidia closed down 14%, marking its largest single-day decline since January 2025. It fell 23% this week, its biggest weekly drop since October 2008.

items.title_zh: 报道：AI服务器厂商涨价幅度最高达45%
items.body_zh: 据媒体报道，戴尔、慧与科技（HPE）、联想和超微电脑正在要求提高AI服务器的价格，涨幅最高达45%，即使是几个月前已签署的协议也不例外。这些更高的成本正在影响交易公司及其他客户。
items.title_en: Report: AI server manufacturers raise prices by up to 45%.
items.body_en: According to media reports, Dell, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), Lenovo, and Supermicro are seeking to raise the prices of AI servers by up to 45%, even for agreements signed several months ago. These higher costs are affecting trading firms and other customers.

items.title_zh: 马斯克：AI行业明年可能面临严重的资金短缺
items.body_zh: 马斯克回应知名深度学习领域开源项目Keras创始人弗朗索瓦·肖莱（François Chollet）并表示，让如此大规模的算力设备通电、冷却并实现稳定运行，极其困难。人工智能行业明年可能面临严重的资金短缺。如果全行业从支付算力成本到设备能够稳定创收的时间累计推迟数月，仅营运资金就可能需要额外投入数千亿美元，马斯克反问这些资金将从何而来。
items.title_en: Elon Musk: The AI industry may face a severe funding shortage next year.
items.body_en: Musk responded to François Chollet, founder of the well-known open-source project Keras in the field of deep learning, stating that it is extremely difficult to power, cool, and stably operate computing equipment on such a large scale. The AI industry may face a severe funding shortfall next year. If the entire industry experiences a cumulative delay of several months, from paying for computing power costs to the time when equipment can generate stable revenue, working capital alone could require an additional investment of hundreds of billions of dollars. Musk questioned where these funds would come from.

items.title_zh: 融资保证金比例下限降至80%，有望释放4000亿元增量资金
items.body_zh: 11月22日，经中国证监会批准，沪深北交易所发布《关于调整融资保证金比例等相关安排的通知》，将融资保证金比例下限从100%降低至80%。据业内测算，融资保证金比例下限降至80%，有助于降低新增资金开仓成本、盘活融资合约存量资金，有望释放4000亿元增量资金。（上证报）
items.title_en: The lower limit of the margin requirement for margin trading has been reduced to 80%, which is expected to release an additional RMB 400 billion in funds.
items.body_en: On November 22, with the approval of the CSRC, the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing Stock Exchanges issued the "Notice on Adjusting the Margin Ratio for Financing and Other Related Arrangements," reducing the lower limit of the margin ratio for financing from 100% to 80%. According to industry estimates, lowering the minimum margin ratio for financing to 80% helps reduce the cost of opening new positions with additional funds and activates existing funds in financing contracts, potentially releasing RMB 400 billion in incremental capital. (Shanghai Securities News).

items.title_zh: 商务部新闻发言人就美国联邦通信委员会拟禁止中国电信运营商直接获取美国互联网电话号码资源答记者问
items.body_zh: 问：美东时间11月19日，美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）投票通过有关规则，拟禁止中国电信、中国联通、中国移动等被列入“覆盖清单”的电信运营商直接获取美国互联网电话号码资源。请问商务部对此有何评论？ 答：我们注意到有关情况。美国联邦通信委员会滥用监管权力，泛化所谓国家安全风险，在缺乏事实依据的情况下，违反非歧视和公平竞争原则，肆意污蔑、恶意打压中国电信企业在美运营。
items.title_en: The Ministry of Commerce Spokesperson Answers Reporters' Questions Regarding the U.S. Federal Communications Commission's Proposed Ban on Chinese Telecom Operators Directly Obtaining U.S. Internet Phone Number Resources.
items.body_en: Q: On November 19, U.S. Eastern Time, the U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) voted to adopt rules that would prohibit telecommunications operators such as China Telecom, China Unicom, and China Mobile, which are included on the "Covered List," from directly obtaining U.S. Internet telephone number resources. What is the Ministry of Commerce's comment on this? Answer: We have taken note of the relevant situation. The U.S. Federal Communications Commission has abused its regulatory authority and generalized the so-called national security risks. Without any factual basis, it has violated the principles of non-discrimination and fair competition, wantonly slandering and maliciously suppressing the operations of Chinese telecommunications companies in the United States.

items.title_zh: 深交所就创业板做市交易业务相关规则公开征求意见
items.body_zh: 本次征求意见的《做市业务细则》，对创业板股票做市交易业务进行管理。一是明确做市服务申请备案要求。经中国证监会核准取得上市证券做市交易业务资格的证券公司，以备案方式向深交所申请为创业板股票提供做市服务。二是明确做市商权利与义务。做市商应通过做市专用证券账户开展做市交易业务。深交所定期对做市商做市服务进行评价，激励做市商积极履行做市义务。三是明确对做市商的监督管理要求。
items.title_en: The Shenzhen Stock Exchange Seeks Public Comments on Rules Related to Market-Making Trading on the ChiNext Market.
items.body_en: The "Detailed Rules for Market Making Business" for which comments are being solicited this time govern the market making trading business for ChiNext stocks. First, the requirements for applying for the filing of market-making services are clarified. Securities companies that have been approved by the CSRC to qualify for listed securities market making trading business shall apply to the SZSE for providing market making services for ChiNext stocks by filing. Second, the rights and obligations of market makers are clarified. Market makers shall conduct market-making trading business through dedicated market-making securities accounts. The SZSE regularly evaluates market makers' market-making services to incentivize them to actively fulfill their market-making obligations. Third, clarify the supervisory and regulatory requirements for market makers.

items.title_en: The world's first stationary full-power generator is put into operation.
items.body_en: On November 20, the world's first 35 kV/30 MVA IGBT series static full-power generator, independently developed by State Grid Corporation of China, was officially put into operation at the 330 kV Fanghe Substation in Yan'an, Shaanxi, after 168 hours of trial operation following a short-circuit test. items.body_zh: 美国民主党将在明年掌控美国国会后举行听证会，研究如何撤销特朗普经济政策中的关键内容，包括关税和税收政策。众议院负责贸易和税收事务的民主党最高级别议员理查德·尼尔表示，他计划对特朗普实施的各项关税政策展开全面调查。尼尔表示，他还将审查特朗普政府推出的税收优惠政策，包括加剧美国财政赤字的大规模减税措施，并将恢复数百万美国人享有的政府医疗补贴列为优先事项。
items.title_en: Report: U.S. Democrats to Seek Overturn of Trump's Tax and Tariff Policies.
items.body_en: After taking control of the U.S. Congress next year, the Democratic Party will hold hearings to study how to reverse key elements of Trump's economic policies, including tariffs and tax policies. Richard Neal, the highest-ranking Democratic member of the House of Representatives responsible for trade and tax matters, stated that he plans to conduct a comprehensive investigation into the various tariff policies implemented by Trump. Neal also stated that he will review the tax incentives introduced by the Trump administration, including the large-scale tax cuts that have exacerbated the U.S. budget deficit, and will prioritize the restoration of government healthcare subsidies enjoyed by millions of Americans.

story.era: 欧洲 · 布达佩斯投机家
story.title_zh: 经济和股市，是主人和狗
story.title_en: The Economy and the Dog on a Leash
story.body_zh: 科斯托拉尼有个流传最广的比喻：经济是主人，股市是狗。狗前后乱跑，但拴着绳，最终都会跟着主人回家。他从不因股市涨跌过度兴奋或恐慌，只盯着绳子另一头。他的忠告：有耐心的人才会赢。
story.body_en: André Kostolany left behind his most famous picture. The economy is the owner. The stock market is the dog. The dog runs ahead, then falls behind. But the leash connects them, and both arrive home together. Patience wins. Money alone does not.

lines.en: A park in Europe. An old speculator is walking a big restless dog, and a young admirer is walking beside him.
lines.zh: 欧洲某公园。一个老投机家牵着一只躁动的大狗散步，身边跟着个仰慕他的年轻人。

lines.en: Monsieur, the market ran up three percent this week, then fell back two. What should I do?
lines.zh: 先生，这周股市涨了百分之三，又跌回去两个点。我该怎么办？

lines.en: Look at my dog. He runs ahead of me, then falls behind. Up and down, back and forth.
lines.zh: 看我的狗。他一会儿冲到我前面，一会儿又落在后面。上蹿下跳，来回折腾。

lines.en: But he always ends up where you end up?
lines.zh: 但最后他都跟着您走到同一个地方？

lines.en: Exactly. The economy is the owner. The market is the dog. Watch the far end of the leash, not the dog.
lines.zh: 正是。经济是主人，股市是狗。盯住绳子另一头的主人，别盯狗。

lines.en: After seventy years in markets, his advice was simple. Patience wins. Money alone does not.
lines.zh: 在股海浮沉七十年后，他的忠告只有一句：有耐心的人才会赢，光有钱不行。

joke.title_zh: 爱因斯坦说复利是第八大奇迹？
joke.title_en: Did Einstein Call Compounding the Eighth Wonder?
joke.body_zh: 据说爱因斯坦讲过：复利是世界第八大奇迹，懂的人赚它，不懂的人付它。这句话他大概率没说过，却成了金融圈流传最广的名言。真假不重要，道理是真的：时间+利率，是普通人和财富之间最诚实的一条路。反过来也一样，利滚利的债，也会按同样的数学惩罚不守纪律的人。
joke.body_en: People say Einstein once called compound interest the eighth wonder of the world. Those who understand it earn it. Those who do not, pay it. He probably never said it. But the quote refuses to die, because the math is real. Time, plus a steady rate, is the most honest road to wealth for ordinary people. And the road works both ways. Debt compounds too, with the same mathematics, punishing those who break their rules.

items.body_zh: 标普500指数跌3.1%，纳斯达克100指数跌4.9%，纳指跌4.6%，半导体指数跌10%，Anthropic维持大约10%的跌幅。 英伟达跌11.79%，闪迪跌16%，博通跌12.58%，美光跌13.22%，英特尔跌6.13%，AMD跌13.59%，高通跌5.29%，台积电跌9.30%，阿斯麦跌6.70%。 VIX波动率日内涨幅达22.5%，报34.85。 美国2-7年期国债收益率至少跌15个基点。

items.title_zh: 欧洲股市创2025年以来最大周跌幅，科技股重挫
items.body_zh: 随着市场对人工智能（AI）热潮能否持续的疑虑再度升温，从股票到铜等全球资产均受到冲击，欧洲股市录得2025年4月以来最大单周跌幅。 斯托克欧洲600指数收盘下跌2%，本周累计跌幅扩大至5.8%。科技分类指数本周重挫11%，创2020年3月以来最大单周跌幅。随着铜和黄金价格下跌，矿业股也走低。 投资者转而买入个人护理、食品和医疗保健等更具防御性的板块。
items.title_en: European stock markets experience their largest weekly decline since 2025, with tech stocks taking a significant hit.
items.body_en: As market doubts about the sustainability of the artificial intelligence (AI) boom resurface, global assets ranging from stocks to copper have been impacted, with European stock markets recording their largest weekly decline since April 2025. The STOXX Europe 600 Index closed down 2%, bringing its cumulative decline for the week to 5.8%. The technology sector index plummeted by 11% this week, marking its largest weekly decline since March 2020. As copper and gold prices fell, mining stocks also declined. Investors have shifted to buying more defensive sectors such as personal care, food, and healthcare.

items.title_zh: 普兰特莫兰金融顾问公司（Plante Moran Financial Adv
items.body_zh: 普兰特莫兰金融顾问公司（Plante Moran Financial Advisors）首席投资官Jim Baird：市场原本希望Anthropic的IPO能带来持续提振，但其股价走势反映出外界对AI领域更广泛的担忧。 Anthropic上市之际，正值市场对该行业普遍持怀疑态度之时，人们对其能否在短期内兑现日益高企的预期存在诸多疑问。
items.title_en: Plante Moran Financial Advisors.
items.body_en: Jim Baird, Chief Investment Officer at Plante Moran Financial Advisors: The market had hoped that Anthropic's IPO would provide a sustained boost, but its share price performance reflects broader concerns about the AI sector. Anthropic's IPO comes at a time when the market is generally skeptical of the industry, with many questions about whether it can meet increasingly high expectations in the short term.

items.title_zh: 彭博经济研究（Bloomberg Economics）经济学家Anna Wong
items.body_zh: Anthropic的这笔（美国IPO）交易可能标志着AI交易热潮的终结。 该公司的财务数据显示前沿智能领域的定价能力正在减弱，这意味着即便市场对AI服务存在巨大需求，领先的提供商也很难让客户支付足够高的费用，以证明其巨额支出的合理性。
items.title_en: Anna Wong, Economist at Bloomberg Economics.
items.body_en: Anthropic's (U.S. IPO) deal may mark the end of the AI dealmaking boom. The company's financial data shows that pricing power in the cutting-edge AI sector is weakening, meaning that even with strong market demand for AI services, leading providers are struggling to charge customers enough to justify their substantial expenditures.

items.title_zh: 欧盟与印尼签署贸易和投资协定
items.body_zh: 欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩称，欧盟与印度尼西亚（印尼）签署了综合性经济合作伙伴协议与投资保护协议，以期促进贸易与投资。 欧盟委员会在一份新闻稿中表示，协议取消了欧盟商品出口到印尼的98.5%税目项下的进口关税。这两项协议现在都需要欧洲议会的批准。 印尼当局也在进行其内部的批准程序。
items.title_en: EU and Indonesia Sign Trade and Investment Agreement.
items.body_en: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen stated that the European Union (EU) and Indonesia have signed a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement and an Investment Protection Agreement with the aim of promoting trade and investment. In a press release, the European Commission stated that the agreement eliminates import tariffs on 98.5% of tariff lines for EU goods exported to Indonesia. Both agreements now require approval from the European Parliament. The Indonesian authorities are also undergoing their internal approval process.

items.title_zh: 美股七巨头收盘播报｜周五（11月20日），美国科技股七巨头（Magnific
items.body_zh: 美股七巨头收盘播报｜周五（11月20日），美国科技股七巨头（Magnificent 7）指数跌5.01%，报194.71点，本周累计下跌10.28%，11月16-18日维持小幅下跌，19日（Anthropic美国IPO首日）以来持续扩大跌幅。 英伟达收盘重挫14%，创2025年1月份以来最大单日跌幅；本周重挫23%，创2008年10月份以来最大单周跌幅。
items.title_en: Closing Report on the U.S. Magnificent Seven Stocks | On Friday (November 20), the U.S. Magnificent Seven tech stocks.
items.body_en: U.S. Magnificent 7 Closing Report｜On Friday (November 20), the U.S. Magnificent 7 tech stocks index fell 5.01% to 194.71 points, with a cumulative decline of 10.28% this week. It remained slightly down from November 16–18 and has continued to widen its decline since November 19 (the first day of Anthropic's U.S. IPO). Nvidia closed down 14%, marking its largest single-day decline since January 2025. It fell 23% this week, its biggest weekly drop since October 2008.

During a Q&A session with reporters on Saturday, Zelensky named current Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha...

items.title_zh: MSCI新兴市场股票指数跌入熊市，AI引发全球抛售
items.body_zh: 11月20日，MSCI新兴市场股票指数跌入熊市，七连跌创2024年以来最长连跌纪录，全球科技股遭遇抛售。明晟公司MSCI新兴市场股票指数跌3.1%，较6月峰值累计回撤21%；单周跌幅创2020年3月以来最大，随着Anthropic PBC上市不久下跌，加上英伟达再曝丑闻，对人工智能（AI）交易的疑虑演变成全面抛售。 MSCI发展中国家外汇指数跌0.05%。
items.title_en: MSCI Emerging Markets Equity Index enters bear market, AI triggers global sell-off.
items.body_en: On November 20, the MSCI Emerging Markets Equity Index entered a bear market, with seven consecutive declines marking the longest streak of declines since 2024, as global tech stocks faced a sell-off. The MSCI Emerging Markets Equity Index fell by 3.1%, representing a cumulative drawdown of 21% from its June peak. This marked the largest weekly decline since March 2020. As Anthropic PBC experienced a decline shortly after its IPO, coupled with another scandal involving Nvidia, concerns about artificial intelligence (AI) trades escalated into a widespread sell-off. The MSCI Emerging Markets Currency Index fell by 0.05%.

items.title_zh: 科技股抛售搅动市场，AI信用风险指标恶化，谷歌CDS创历史新高
items.body_zh: 由于人工智能（AI）交易的动摇引发全球市场波动，周五，部分最大规模超大规模云厂商（hyperscalers）和芯片制造商的信用风险指标攀升，同时其债券价格走弱。 根据ICE数据服务（ICE Data Services）的数据，为甲骨文公司债务提供五年期违约保护的成本最多攀升4.2个基点，达到327.9个基点，创10月20日以来最高水平。
items.title_en: Tech stock sell-off shakes up the market, AI credit risk indicators worsen, and Google CDS hits an all-time high.
items.body_en: On Friday, credit risk indicators for some of the largest hyperscalers and chip manufacturers rose, while their bond prices weakened, as fluctuations in artificial intelligence (AI) trading triggered volatility in global markets. According to ICE Data Services, the cost of five-year default protection on Oracle's debt rose by up to 4.2 basis points to 327.9 basis points, the highest level since October 20.

items.title_en: Lan Fo'an Attends the Signing Ceremony for the Agreement on the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank Hong Kong Office.
items.body_en: On November 21, the signing ceremony for the agreement establishing the Hong Kong office of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) was held in Hong Kong. Minister of Finance Lan Fo'an attended the ceremony and, on behalf of the Chinese government, co-signed the agreement with AIIB President Jin Liqun. Over the week, they fell by a cumulative 19.14 basis points, trading within the range of 5.1494%–4.9039%. items.title_zh: 随着AI市场持续暴跌，铜价或将录得19个月来最大单周跌幅
items.body_zh: 受人工智能（AI）领域投资热情持续减弱影响，周五铜价暴跌至3月以来最低点，并有望创下逾19个月来最大单周跌幅。截至17:01 GMT， 伦敦金属交易所（LME）基准三个月期铜价格下跌3%，报每公吨12,150美元。 此前，该价格一度 触及12,020美元，创下自3月24日以来的新低。这种被认为将在人工智能基础设施建设中发挥巨大作用的金属，本周已下跌约9.3%，恐将创2025年4月4日当周以来最大的单周跌幅。
items.title_en: As the AI market continues to plummet, copper prices may record their largest weekly decline in 19 months.
items.body_en: Due to the continued waning of investment enthusiasm in the field of artificial intelligence (AI), copper prices plummeted to their lowest level since March on Friday and are expected to record their largest weekly decline in over 19 months. As of 17:01 GMT, the London Metal Exchange (LME) benchmark three-month copper price fell by 3% to $12,150 per metric ton. Earlier, the price had briefly touched $12,020, marking its lowest level since March 24. This metal, which is expected to play a significant role in the construction of AI infrastructure, has fallen by about 9.3% this week and is likely to record its largest weekly decline since the week of April 4, 2024.

items.body_zh: 过去一直很难真正摸清AI需求的底细，而Anthropic正是这个问题的答案。 我们将更清楚地了解AI在需求和回报方面的上行空间，与此同时，我们也将更加深刻地认识到这项业务烧钱有多么疯狂、成本有多么高昂。

items.body_en: In the past, it has always been difficult to truly understand the details of AI demand, and Anthropic is the answer to this question. We will gain a clearer understanding of the upside potential of AI in terms of demand and returns. At the same time, we will also develop a deeper appreciation of just how wildly cash-intensive and costly this business is.

The draft prospectus shows that, after deducting issuance expenses, the funds raised from this corporate bond offering are intended for productive expenditures, specifically including the repayment of maturing debts, replenishment of working capital, project construction and operation, equity acquisitions, and other uses permitted by applicable laws, regulations, and/or regulatory authorities.
